sources.title: SIL Open Font License Version 1.1
sources.excerpt: "The requirement for fonts to remain under this license does not apply to any document created using the Font Software." Reserved Font Name condition applies to Modified Versions of the Font Software.

sources.title: OFL FAQ
sources.excerpt: Q1.1 permits using OFL fonts for any design work including logos and graphics based on their outlines. Q1.1.1: "You remain the author and copyright holder of that newly derived graphic... It is only when you redistribute, bundle or modify the font itself that other conditions of the license have to be respected." Outlined artwork is a DOCUMENT, not a Modified Version, so the Reserved Font Name does not attach to it.
